title: Indian polity: key Articles of the Constitution
license: Headings from the Constitution of India (a Government of India text); deck arrangement CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 like the rest of this list

source.title: The Constitution of India (Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice)

note: Each answer is the Article's heading as in the official text; read the Article itself for the full provision.

cards.front: Article 12 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Definition of "the State" for Part III (Fundamental Rights).

cards.front: Article 13 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights.

cards.front: Article 14 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Equality before law.

cards.front: Article 15 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth.

cards.front: Article 16 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.

cards.front: Article 17 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Abolition of Untouchability.

cards.front: Article 19 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc..

cards.front: Article 20 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection in respect of conviction for offences.

cards.front: Article 21 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection of life and personal liberty.

cards.front: Article 21A of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Right to education.

cards.front: Article 22 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases.

cards.front: Article 23 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour.

cards.front: Article 24 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc..

cards.front: Article 25 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion.

cards.front: Article 29 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection of interests of minorities.

cards.front: Article 30 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions.

cards.front: Article 32 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Remedies for enforcement of rights conferred by Part III.

cards.front: Article 39A of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Equal justice and free legal aid.

cards.front: Article 40 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Organisation of village panchayats.

cards.front: Article 44 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Uniform civil code for the citizens.

cards.front: Article 48A of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life.

cards.front: Article 50 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Separation of judiciary from executive.

cards.front: Article 51 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Promotion of international peace and security.

cards.front: Article 51A of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Fundamental duties.

cards.front: Article 72 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of President to grant pardons, etc., and to suspend, remit or commute sentences in certain cases.

cards.front: Article 110 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Definition of "Money Bills".

cards.front: Article 112 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Annual financial statement (the Budget).

cards.front: Article 123 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of President to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament.

cards.front: Article 143 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of President to consult Supreme Court.

cards.front: Article 148 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Comptroller and Auditor-General of India.

cards.front: Article 213 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of Governor to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Legislature.

cards.front: Article 226 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of High Courts to issue certain writs.

cards.front: Article 280 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Finance Commission.

cards.front: Article 300A of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law.

cards.front: Article 312 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: All-India services.

cards.front: Article 315 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Public Service Commissions for the Union and for the States.

cards.front: Article 324 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Superintendence, direction and control of elections to be vested in an Election Commission.

cards.front: Article 326 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Elections to the House of the People and to the Legislative Assemblies of States to be on the basis of adult suffrage.

cards.front: Article 352 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Proclamation of Emergency.

cards.front: Article 356 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Provisions in case of failure of constitutional machinery in States.

cards.front: Article 360 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Provisions as to financial emergency.

cards.front: Article 368 of the Constitution of India: what is it about?
cards.back: Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor.
